title: Addendum — PRD grounding
summary: PRD addendum grounding NOVATEK Capture non-functional requirements: field touchscreen/device criteria, 2026 PWA storage/sync/media limits, and testable audit-trail invariants, each with a primary-source trap list.
scope: NOVATEK Capture field capture flow (photo, voice note, asset select, proposal ACCEPT/REJECT, work-order submit)
touch target sizing: 20 mm physical for consequential controls (NFR-UI-01), 44 CSS px for all others (NFR-UI-02)
no gesture-only or swipe-only actions (NFR-UI-03)
dual-channel sub-100 ms confirmation feedback and idempotent controls (NFR-UI-04)
text contrast 7:1 and non-text contrast 3:1, state never by hue alone (NFR-UI-05, NFR-UI-06)
reflow at 320 CSS px and 200% text scaling; cap of four primary actions per capture screen (NFR-UI-07)
one-handed thumb-zone placement and deliberate separated ACCEPT (NFR-UI-08)
approved device list: firmware glove touch mode and >= 1000 cd/m2 luminance (NFR-DEV-01, NFR-DEV-02, NFR-DEV-03)
gloved outdoor acceptance test with five artisans across three trades (NFR-TEST-01)
CI WCAG 2.2 AA conformance gate plus SC 2.5.5 and SC 1.4.6 (NFR-TEST-02)
conditional ISA-101 HMI alignment and scope disclaimer (NFR-HMI-01, NFR-HMI-02)
iOS Home Screen install as prerequisite for offline capture; standalone display-mode check (NFR-STORAGE-1)
navigator.storage.persist() requested and verified, never assumed (NFR-STORAGE-2)
runtime storage budget via estimate(); working cap lesser of 2 GB / 50% quota (NFR-STORAGE-3)
QuotaExceededError handling with defined degradation order (NFR-STORAGE-4)
server as system of record; wiped-store detection and re-hydration (NFR-STORAGE-5)
maximum supported offline window of 72 hours (NFR-STORAGE-6)
foreground-driven reconciliation; Background Sync as Chromium-only accelerator with no SLA (NFR-SYNC-1, NFR-SYNC-2)
durable IndexedDB commit before UI acknowledgement and before visibilitychange-hidden; document.wasDiscarded recovery (NFR-DURABILITY-1, NFR-DURABILITY-2)
MediaRecorder format negotiated at runtime, audio/mp4 AAC on iOS; STT accepts AAC-in-MP4; no background recording (NFR-MEDIA-1, NFR-MEDIA-2, NFR-MEDIA-3)
HTTPS secure-context precondition and iframe allow=camera; microphone (NFR-SECURITY-1, NFR-SECURITY-2)
Android WebAPK hibernation permission re-request; platform floor iOS 17+, Chrome Android 55+/61+ (NFR-PLATFORM-1, NFR-PLATFORM-2)
per-session platform-limit telemetry (NFR-OBSERVABILITY-1)
AcceptanceGate single mediating writer for Finding records (MEDIATION)
Finding commit preconditions: authenticated, assigned artisan, Proposal PENDING, explicit accept (PRECONDITION)
only the assigned artisan may accept a Proposal, identified and recorded (NAMED-HUMAN AUTHORITY)
Acceptance Architecture Description enumerating every interface to the finding store (NON-BYPASSABILITY)
machine pipeline may create PROPOSAL only, never a Finding (MACHINE NON-AUTHORITY)
attribution fields: printed name, identifier, timestamp with zone, source Proposal text, meaning (ATTRIBUTION, HUMAN-READABLE MANIFESTATION)
secure time-stamped audit trail for every Proposal/Finding action; non-obscuring changes (AUDIT TRAIL GENERATION, NON-OBSCURING)
prevent-or-detect declaration per audit invariant (PREVENT-OR-DETECT DECLARATION)
acceptance as its own on-device transaction with retained device and server timestamps (OFFLINE COMMIT POINT, TIME TRUST)
attestation bound to Finding by ordinary means; integrity check and rejection on reconciliation (SIGNATURE/RECORD BINDING, TAMPER DETECTION ON RECONCILIATION)
audit retention and exportability (AUDIT AVAILABILITY)
verification-method column and positive-phrasing rule for PRD requirements (process requirements)
consolidated do-not-use register of untraceable platform, standards and regulatory claims
notes: Type taken from MANIFEST_TYPE=PRD; precedence from MANIFEST_PRECEDENCE=3. Content agrees: sections 1.1, 2.1 and 3.1 are candidate requirements in SHALL form with IDs (NFR-UI-*, NFR-DEV-*, NFR-TEST-*, NFR-HMI-*, NFR-STORAGE-*, NFR-SYNC-*, NFR-DURABILITY-*, NFR-MEDIA-*, NFR-SECURITY-*, NFR-PLATFORM-*, NFR-OBSERVABILITY-*, and named audit invariants), several carrying verification methods and acceptance criteria. Ambiguity noted for the synthesizer: the body is predominantly non-functional/technical (storage quotas, codecs, secure-context, audit mechanisms) and would read as SPEC on content alone; the manifest override is honoured. Frontmatter status is 'draft'; the document self-rates thread 1 and thread 3 at 'medium' confidence and thread 2 at 'high', and labels most items 'candidate' or 'proposed' (e.g. 72-hour offline window, 2 GB cap), so the synthesizer should treat numeric values as proposals not settled requirements. Sections x.2 and section 0 are 'do not use' trap lists (context, not requirements) and should not be extracted as requirements. NFR-HMI-01 is explicitly gated on purchasing ISA-101.01-2015. The second cross_ref (prd.md) is implied by the in-text reference 'see PRD §0' rather than written as a path. Filename hash suffix is a stable placeholder, not a computed SHA-256, because no shell tool was available in this session.
